title: Understanding and Mitigating Toxicity in Image-Text Pretraining Datasets: A Case Study on LLaVA

bias_targets.methodology: Automated multimodal filtering and classification of image-text pairs using LlavaGuard 7B for visual content (categorizing into safety policies like Hate/Harassment) and Toxic-BERT for textual content (detecting identity-based hate, threats, and obscenity), with results refined and verified using Command R+.
